schemes.label: ECDSA-STARK (baseline)
schemes.notes: Classical control. Shor-breakable; not a PQ candidate. Proves the pipeline.

schemes.label: Falcon-512 SHAKE-256 (standard)
schemes.standardized: NIST-selected (FN-DSA, FIPS 206 pending); standard SHAKE-256 hash-to-point
schemes.offchain_prep: signer supplies mul hint (s1*h mod q; +29 sig felts)
schemes.notes: Standards-compliant hash-to-point: SHAKE-256 exactly per the Falcon specification, so signatures interoperate with any compliant signer (e.g. falcon.py). Hint-based verify: two generated forward NTTs check a signer-supplied s1*h pointwise. On-chain cost is dominated by the pure-Cairo Keccak-f[1600]; a native keccak_f1600 syscall (SNIP-32) would remove most of it.

schemes.label: Falcon-512 SHAKE-256 direct (standard, no hint)
schemes.standardized: NIST-selected (FN-DSA, FIPS 206 pending); standard SHAKE-256 hash-to-point
schemes.notes: The closest on-chain match to a bare standard Falcon signature: standard SHAKE-256 hash-to-point with the hint-free direct core, so only the 31-felt s1||salt is supplied. s1*h is computed with one generated forward NTT and the forward-graph inverse (gather-and-twist, forward transform, untwist), which keeps it within about 2% of the hint variant's cost.
